title: Enforce work readiness and outcome-based partitioning

outcomes.statement: The repository classifies every new US and CHG from a strict, outcome-based assessment and blocks oversized, unresolved, or unapproved work.
outcomes.demo: Model fixtures reject every hard-limit violation for user stories and functional or technical changes, validate vertical proposals, and accept only matching digest-bound approval.

outcomes.statement: Every implementation entry point enforces the same readiness decision, plan budget, checkpoint lifecycle, and completion calibration contract.
outcomes.demo: CLI, commit-hook, staged-change, Git-range, and repository-gate fixtures reject missing, stale, bypassed, or non-executable readiness while a compliant approved item passes.

outcomes.statement: Generated agent guidance preserves the readiness gate and Substrate receives structured sizing and estimate-versus-actual evidence.
outcomes.demo: Reconciliation tests repair all governed guidance from the immutable CHG-022 overlay, and schema-valid Nous feedback records approval provenance, verification, actuals, and recommendations.

uncertainties.statement: The gate must activate while its own validator and enforcement entry points do not yet exist.
uncertainties.resolution: Use the digest-bound CHG-022 authorization as the sole immutable bootstrap; its exact path manifest permits only the files needed to activate and verify the gate. The impact is included in readiness and integration.

uncertainties.statement: Generated agent guidance cannot be made durable by an untracked local edit.
uncertainties.resolution: Carry the approved rule through an append-only four-file overlay plus the existing reconciler and its tests. The impact is included in implementation and review.

uncertainties.statement: Approval could be replayed after readiness scope changes if it were bound only to an evidence identifier.
uncertainties.resolution: Bind the root and approval to the canonical readiness payload SHA-256 and require the matching Nous decision to state that exact digest. The impact is included in implementation and focused verification.

bootstrap_exemption_rationale: The gate cannot use its not-yet-existing validator to partition and approve its own activation. CHG-022 therefore has no official children despite its honest 360-minute, three-outcome, 21-file assessment. This immutable one-time authorization permits only the approved activation manifest; it is not normal two-hour compliance, cannot be copied, and does not authorize later expansion.
